estimates: The model covers the present mapped palace exterior, deep arcades, entrance hall, receding upper floor, hipped tiled pavilions and east forecourt fountain. Heights, bay counts outside the three documented porch arches, range roof outlines and rear details are estimates.

The unaltered elevation field fixes the east stair and footprint grade. The stone plinth and stair lengths are approximated within that slope. The ground map and published gross floor areas describe different measurement boundaries.

Carved jali, badges, balusters and finials use simplified original geometry. Written architectural records and the named outline establish the exterior; the historical photograph’s current record leaves its release unresolved.

review.notes: Written site surveys and the metro project report establish the Italian arcades, the three principal entrance arches, the stone and stucco articulation, and the tiled pavilion roofs. Internal partitions, absolute architectural heights and corner details are estimated.
